auth object with empty username in basic auth is rejected

```swift title="Swift"
import Crawlberg

do {
    let engineConfig = try crawlConfigFromJson("{\"auth\":{\"password\":\"secret\",\"type\":\"basic\",\"username\":\"\"}}")
    let engineObj = try createEngine(config: engineConfig)
    let url = "https://example.com"
    _ = try await Crawlberg.scrape(engine: engineObj, url: url)
} catch {
    let _errorMessage = String(describing: error)
    let _errorType = String(describing: type(of: error))
    XCTAssertTrue(_errorMessage.contains("auth") || _errorType.contains("auth"), "expected error to mention \"auth\", got message: \(_errorMessage), type: \(_errorType)")
}
```
